description: Frozen gold for the retrieve P@5 baseline harness (specs/retrieve-p5.md A2, A8). Twelve queries over eval/corpus/retrieve-v1.json, inside the frozen 8-15 band. Each entry is query text plus the chunk ids that answer it; relevance is binary and there is no expected ordering, because the metric only asks whether a relevant id landed in the fused top five. Editing this file invalidates every recorded baseline.
